import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import finitewave as fw
n = 100
tissue = fw.CardiacTissue([n, n])
model = fw.AlievPanfilov()
model.cardiac_tissue = tissue
model.t_max = 1
model.run()
plt.imshow(model.u)
plt.show()

blocks.heading: Quick Start
blocks.text:
from site_analysis.builders import TrajectoryBuilder
from pymatgen.io.vasp import Xdatcar
xdatcar = Xdatcar('example_data/XDATCAR')
md_structures = xdatcar.structures
trajectory = TrajectoryBuilder().with_structure(md_structures[0]).with_mobile_species('Li').with_spherical_sites(centres=[[0.25, 0.25, 0.25]], radii=1.5).build()
trajectory.trajectory_from_structures(md_structures)
print(trajectory.atoms_trajectory)
